Career-defining work.</h1> <p style="text-align: center;">Lots of tech companies disrupt. But, many fail when they try to scale. We're different. Cockroach DB makes it easier for companies to build and scale apps. This is how and why we're helping some of the most innovative companies on the planet. We tackle problems head-on and focus on solutions that create lasting impact. </p> <h3 style="text-align: center;">Because when our customers win, we all win. </h3> <p> </p> <hr> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h2> <p>The <strong>SQL Queries</strong> team is responsible for the core of Cockroach DB’s query execution and optimization layer. This group designs and delivers features that make our distributed SQL engine fast, reliable, and flexible for a wide range of workloads.</p> <p>AI is transforming how we search, learn, and build, and databases are evolving to keep up.</p> <p>We’re forming a new <strong>Specialized Indexing</strong> subteam within SQL Queries to expand Cockroach DB’s indexing capabilities beyond traditional relational workloads. This team will design and implement high-performance indexing systems such as <strong>vector, full-text, and geospatial indexes</strong> to support the next generation of <strong>AI-native and search-driven applications</strong>.</p> <p>As part of this team, you’ll work on deep systems problems, collaborate across the SQL organization, and build production-quality features that make Cockroach DB a unified platform for both structured and unstructured data.</p> <h2><strong>You Will</strong> </h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain specialized indexing features for Cockroach DB, including <strong>vector</strong>, full-text, and geospatial indexing.</li> <li>Improve the performance and reliability of existing vector indexing systems, including backfill, query planning, and import workflows.</li> <li>Partner with other database teams to integrate new indexing mechanisms into the query engine.</li> <li>Develop hybrid search capabilities that combine vector similarity and text-based search for modern AI and search workloads.</li> <li>Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and release planning within the SQL organization.</li> <li>Take full ownership of your work, from design through implementation, testing, and release.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Expectations</strong></h2> <p><strong>In your first month</strong>, you’ll get familiar with Cockroach DB’s SQL architecture, vector indexing implementation, and the surrounding systems. You’ll also begin contributing to smaller improvements and fixes.</p> <p><strong>Within three months</strong>, you’ll take ownership of components related to specialized indexing, making measurable improvements to performance and reliability.</p> <p><strong>After six months</strong>, you’ll play a key role in advancing hybrid search capabilities and help shape the roadmap for future indexing and search features. </p> <h2><strong>You Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Passion for <strong>databases, indexing systems, and high-performance distributed architectures</strong>.</li> <li>A strong background in backend or systems programming, preferably with <strong>Go, C/C++, or Rust</strong>.</li> <li>Experience working on indexing or query execution systems such as vector, text, or spatial search.</li> <li>Solid understanding of <strong>data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems</strong>.</li> <li>Curiosity about AI-driven and hybrid workloads that combine structured and unstructured data.</li> <li>A focus on building reliable, maintainable, and high-performance software.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with a distributed global team.</li> <li>Typically 10+ years of experience building large-scale, production-grade systems.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous problems into scalable, production-grade AI-enabled solutions.</li> <li>A builder's instinct for reuse and extensibility — your output becomes a platform, pattern, or capability others depend on.</li> <li>Clear judgment about where AI should be deeply integrated and where traditional approaches are more reliable.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Team</strong></h2> <p>The SQL Queries team is one of the most impactful and technically challenging groups at Cockroach Labs. Joining the Specialized Indexing subteam means working at the frontier of databases and AI, helping shape how Cockroach DB powers intelligent, hybrid applications.</p> <p>You’ll be part of a small, autonomous team based in India, collaborating with engineers and leaders across the world. You’ll have the chance to own complex, high-visibility features that directly influence how customers use Cockroach DB.</p> <p>If you’re excited about building innovative systems that push the boundaries of what a database can do, we’d love to meet you.</p> <p> </p> <hr> <p>Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at <a href="mailto:accessibility@cockroachlabs.com">accessibility@cockroachlabs.com</a>.</p> <p>Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays,Thursdays and Fridays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.</p> <hr> <h1>Benefits</h1> <ul> <li>Medical Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Time Off</li> <li>Paid Parental Leave</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing Benefits</li> <li>Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Wellness Allowance</li> <li>Food Allowance </li> <li>Office Commute Reimbursement</li> <li>And more!</li> </ul> </div> </div>

Career-defining work.</h1> <p style="text-align: center;">Lots of tech companies disrupt. But, many fail when they try to scale. We're different. Cockroach DB makes it easier for companies to build and scale apps. This is how and why we're helping some of the most innovative companies on the planet. We tackle problems head-on and focus on solutions that create lasting impact. </p> <h3 style="text-align: center;">Because when our customers win, we all win. </h3> <p> </p> <hr> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h2> <p>Databases must keep going no matter what. At Cockroach Labs, quality is our number one feature. We are software engineers on a mission to push our product to new frontiers. Our work has a broad-reaching impact on the engineering organization of over 100 engineers who rely on our tools and methodology to ship a top-notch quality product.<br><br>Test Engineering is expanding our investment in next-generation test automation and bug-finding techniques, utilizing both randomized and deterministic testing. Note that this is not a QA/manual testing role; all Cockroach Labs engineers write tests and obsess about quality. Test Engineering is a cross-functional team that aims to enable and strengthen the engineering organization by emphasizing correctness and performance testing. <br><br>The work encompasses three primary focus areas: Test Infrastructure, Exploratory Testing, and Performance and Scalability. Speaking broadly, Test Infrastructure enables automated test execution, detection of performance regressions, fuzzing, and much more. Exploratory Testing enables new bug-finding techniques such as static and dynamic analysis, metamorphic testing, failure injection, and others. Performance and Scalability enables at-scale benchmarking.<br><br>Some examples of recent and future projects:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/master/pkg/cmd/roachtest/roachtestutil/mixedversion/README.md">Mixed version</a> framework utilizing<a href="https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/tree/master/pkg/cmd/roachtest#readme"> roachtest</a> and<a href="https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/tree/master/pkg/cmd/roachprod#readme"> roachprod</a></li> <li>Failure injection testing (e.g.,<a href="https://chaos-mesh.org/"> chaos-mesh</a>,<a href="https://github.com/CARV-ICS-FORTH/frisbee"> frisbee</a>)</li> <li>Next generation of<a href="https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/tree/master/pkg/cmd/roachtest"> roachtest</a> and<a href="https://github.com/cockroachdb/roachperf"> roachperf</a></li> <li>Parallelized automated microbenchmarks via<a href="https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/tree/master/pkg/cmd/roachprod-microbench#readme"> roachprod-bench</a></li> <li>Developing a static analysis framework for concurrency bugs</li> <li>Large-scale benchmarking and performance testing</li> <li>Automated flaky test detection and quarantining</li> </ul> <p>The ideal candidate will have worked with massively complex codebases and possesses broad experience in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and automated testing.</p> <h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop test strategies and methodologies.</li> <li>Build and scale test infrastructure.</li> <li>Build tools and frameworks to find bugs in complex distributed systems.</li> <li>Build static and dynamic analyzers.</li> <li>Perform at-scale cloud benchmarking.</li> <li>Prioritize and execute test suites that are representative of customers’ workloads.</li> <li>Rigorous validation habits and deep domain expertise applied to all AI-assisted output.</li> <li>A clear understanding of where AI can be safely integrated and where it introduces unacceptable risk.</li> <li>Final authority over everything that goes to production — AI assists your work; it does not replace your judgment.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Expectations</strong></h2> <p>In your first 30 days, you will become an integrated member of our engineering team. You’ll become familiar with our production systems, software development workflows, and the architectures of Cockroach DB and Cockroach DB Cloud. We believe that it’s essential for you to take the first month to get to know our technology and our company. You’ll work on a “starter project” to help you learn about a particular area and start to get the lay of the land.<br><br>After your first month, you will align with the team’s development objectives and own a medium-sized project to completion.<br><br>By the end of the third month, you will be a fully contributing member of the Test Engineering team. You will also have developed enough familiarity with our engineering processes to propose and scope future projects.</p> <h2><strong>You Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience as a software engineer writing clean, idiomatic code.</li> <li>1+ years of hands-on experience with GCP or AWS.</li> <li>Experience with one of the following: Database or Distributed Systems Testing, Static Code analysis, Failure mode analysis.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills and a collaborative mindset.</li> <li>BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Team</strong></h2> <p><strong>Reporting to Stan Rosenberg
- Director of Engineering</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong> Stan is an experienced engineering leader, having built and scaled high-performing engineering teams and distributed systems at high-tech startups. Prior, he worked as a software engineer and a researcher in formal methods. He holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science from Stevens Institute of Technology. In his free time, he enjoys exploring outdoors while dreaming about days when software works as reliably as a bridge.<br><br><strong>Babu Srithar
- Site Lead, India </strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong> Babu Srithar is the Site Leader for India. He is responsible for our growth strategy and is a cultural champion in the region. He is passionate about building high-quality software products and lean teams by leveraging everyone's potential. He enjoys working with people and learning along the way. Before joining Cockroach Labs, Babu Srithar held senior leadership positions at companies like Nutanix, Clumio and recently he was VP of engineering at Apty where he led the engineering globally. When not at work, he enjoys his time with his 3-year-old and family.<br><br><strong>Isaac Wong
- EVP of Engineering</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong> Isaac is responsible for the health of the engineering organization at Cockroach Labs. He partners closely with teams to ensure we have a balanced culture that promotes quality and innovation in pursuit of our goals. Before joining Cockroach Labs Isaac was in life sciences for 16 years with Medidata Solutions where he had a front row seat on the exciting ride from a 30 person startup to more than 2000 people worldwide. But the lure of distributed, resilient, and consistent SQL databases, along with the amazing technology and culture at Cockroach Labs proved too much. When not working he likes to draw, play the piano, and search NYC for cannolis with his wife and kids. </p> <hr> <p>Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at <a href="mailto:accessibility@cockroachlabs.com">accessibility@cockroachlabs.com</a>.</p> <p>Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.</p> <hr> <h1>Benefits</h1> <ul> <li>Medical Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Time Off</li> <li>Paid Parental Leave</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing Benefits</li> <li>Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Wellness Allowance</li> <li>Food Allowance </li> <li>Office Commute Reimbursement</li> <li>And more!</li> </ul> </div> </div>

Career-defining work.</h1> <p style="text-align: center;">Lots of tech companies disrupt. But, many fail when they try to scale. We're different. Cockroach DB makes it easier for companies to build and scale apps. This is how and why we're helping some of the most innovative companies on the planet. We tackle problems head-on and focus on solutions that create lasting impact. </p> <h3 style="text-align: center;">Because when our customers win, we all win. </h3> <p> </p> <hr> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h2> <p>We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager, Fin Ops to join our Research & Development Operations team, based in Bengaluru, India. This is a high-visibility opportunity to define and mature our Fin Ops capabilities at Cockroach Labs, building on foundational work already underway across our engineering organization and taking our cloud financial management to a new level of rigor, scale, and competitive advantage. You will sit at the intersection of Engineering, Finance, and Operations, responsible for driving cost transparency, surfacing savings opportunities, and ensuring cloud infrastructure spend is managed with discipline and accountability.</p> <p>Cockroach Labs operates a significant cloud infrastructure footprint to power Cockroach DB Cloud and our internal engineering environments. As we scale, the ability to understand, attribute, and optimize that spend is critical to our financial health and margin profile. This role will own the Fin Ops program end-to-end: stewarding the tooling that tracks cloud costs, partnering with Engineering and Finance to embed cost accountability across the organization, and building the cost allocation models that feed margin analysis and executive reporting.</p> <p>R&D Operations plays a crucial role in enabling our organization to exceed customer expectations by shortening feedback loops and accelerating learning. By focusing on coordination and process effectiveness, R&D Operations minimizes friction and allows teams to concentrate on delivering high-quality products and services.</p> <h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own and evolve the Fin Ops tooling platform used to track, report on, and analyze cloud infrastructure costs across AWS, GCP, and other providers, ensuring the data is accurate, timely, and actionable.</li> <li>Establish and run the Fin Ops operating cadence, including regular cost reviews, budget-vs-actuals variance analysis, anomaly detection, and a living optimization backlog with owners, timelines, and dollar-value targets.</li> <li>Build and maintain cost allocation frameworks that attribute cloud spend to products, teams, and customer workloads to support COGS calculation, unit economics, and margin analysis in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Identify and prioritize cloud cost optimization opportunities, including rightsizing, committed use discounts (reserved instances/savings plans), idle resource cleanup, storage tiering, egress reduction, Kubernetes/container cost efficiency, and emerging AI and machine learning infrastructure costs such as GPU compute, model training pipelines, and inference workloads.</li> <li>Manage cloud budgets and forecasts in close partnership with Finance and Engineering leadership; explain variances, surface risks early, and drive corrective action before spend exceeds plan.</li> <li>Drive cost accountability across Engineering by establishing tagging and labeling standards, showback/chargeback models, and cost-aware development practices that embed Fin Ops into the engineering culture.</li> <li>Build executive-level dashboards and reporting to communicate cloud spend trends, savings realized, optimization pipeline, and forecast vs. actuals to senior leadership and the board.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Infrastructure, Procurement, and Finance to align cost reduction initiatives with platform roadmap priorities and business goals, without compromising service quality or engineering velocity.</li> <li>Define governance frameworks, best practices, and Fin Ops policies that can scale with the business, including vendor discount strategy, commitment management, and cloud budget governance.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Expectations</strong></h2> <p>In your first 30 days, you will orient yourself by conducting a thorough review of Cockroach Labs' cloud infrastructure footprint, existing Fin Ops tooling, and current state of cost attribution and tagging. You will meet with key stakeholders across R&D and Finance to understand how cloud spend is tracked today, where the gaps are, and what decisions are being made without the data they deserve. Working closely with Finance, you will kick off the design of a tagging hierarchy that will allow cloud infrastructure costs to be viewed and rolled up across the dimensions that matter most: by team, product, environment, and customer workload.</p> <p>By day 60, you will have finalized the tagging taxonomy with Finance sign-off and begun driving adoption and enforcement across Engineering. You will have established yourself as the SME on our Fin Ops tooling platform, leading the first internal training, handling configuration changes, and becoming the go-to resource for questions from budget owners and team leads. You will also have built and published the first cost optimization backlog, identifying the highest-value efficiency opportunities surfaced by the tool and beginning to execute on the most actionable of them.</p> <p>By day 90, you will have established yourself as the definitive expert on where Cockroach Labs' cloud spend is occurring, and why. You will have partnered with Finance and budget owners to put budgets in place by category, delivered the first quarterly cloud spend report to leadership, and helped teams build the dashboards and showback views they need to make cost-aware decisions. When anomalies or trends surface, you will be the person who can explain them to an engineer, a finance partner, or an executive, with clarity and confidence.</p> <h2><strong>You Have</strong> </h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in program management, cloud financial management, or a closely related field, with a proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives independently.</li> <li>Hands-on Fin Ops tooling experience: production-grade experience with a dedicated Fin Ops platform (specifically Cloud Zero, Vantage, or Finout) is required, in addition to proficiency with native CSP cost management tools (AWS Cost Explorer / Cost & Usage Reports, GCP Billing, Azure Cost Management).</li> <li>Strong financial acumen: practical experience with budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost allocation methodologies including showback, chargeback, and COGS/margin attribution.</li> <li>Deep understanding of cloud pricing models: committed use discounts, reserved instances, savings plans, spot/preemptible pricing, data egress costs, storage tiers, and managed service pricing across major cloud providers.</li> <li>Cost allocation and unit economics fluency: demonstrated ability to build or mature cost allocation frameworks that attribute shared infrastructure spend to products or customers in support of gross margin analysis.</li> <li>Data analysis skills: comfortable working with large, complex billing datasets and translating raw cost data into actionable insights; experience building BI dashboards in Looker, Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools.</li> <li>Cross-functional influence: a track record of driving cost governance and cultural change across engineering and finance teams without direct authority, aligning engineers, finance partners, and senior leaders around shared cost accountability.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills: ability to present complex cost data clearly to both technical (infrastructure engineers, SREs) and non-technical (CFO, board) audiences.</li> <li>A demonstrated practice of integrating AI tools into your daily workflow to improve speed, quality, and decision-making.</li> <li>Fluency with AI across core tasks — research, drafting, analysis, planning — used as a default, not an exception.</li> <li>Fin Ops Certified Practitioner (FOCP) or higher (e.g., Fin Ops Certified Professional) strongly preferred; cloud platform certifications (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and familiarity with the Fin Ops for AI framework are a plus.</li> <li>Experience building or maturing a Fin Ops practice is a significant differentiator; we are looking for someone comfortable operating in ambiguity, excited to define what great Fin Ops looks like at Cockroach Labs, and forward-thinking enough to extend cost governance into emerging areas like AI and machine learning infrastructure.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Team</strong></h2> <p>This role reports to Colin Minihan, Director of R&D Operations, and sits within the R&D Operations organization.
